shown.message:
The paper's main text does not fit in 8 pages, so I posted the failure on `paper-repo`#4. As submitted it would be rejected automatically.

- **What the build shows:** in the build of commit `0bb6c8d`, page 8 ends mid-sentence in the Discussion ("Wald intervals are the"). Page 9 opens with about 12 more lines of the Discussion, up to "made after the first results", before the Impact Statement starts.
- **Inconsistency:** that commit's message says the text was trimmed to fit 8 pages, but the build says otherwise.
- **What I asked for:** cut or move to the appendix at least those 12 lines, plus about 0.3 page of slack. That is roughly 25 to 30 lines in this two-column layout. I also asked them to re-check on the built PDF of the commit they offer for approval.
- **What is fine:** the main text holds 3 full-width figures and 1 full-width table, within budget. References are at 26.

I did not re-check ICML's promised submission-process update this turn. I'll do that before a version is approved.
